text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As the end of the year draws 
near—December.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The greatest showdown of the year was 
finally about to begin.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The time is upon us, Trainer, Mirako. This 
coming battle—is on a whole different 
level than anything before.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"After all, the Arima Kinen features the 
older generation... fierce, 
battle-hardened veterans. And among them, 
of course――"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: I can sense “their” presence, too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh, No Reason-chan, who do you mean by 
'those scoundrels'...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
'Those guys.' The meaning behind those 
words points to only one thing—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Fortunately for our generation, no 
formidable warlords emerged from the 
Silent Clan.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
However... the older generation is a 
different story. Formidable foes backed by 
powerful forces roam unchecked.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
However! As if we'll let them run rampant 
forever! Who do the Silent Clan think they 
are?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Let us go, Mirako. We shall give them, and 
Lord Kris S as well, a taste of what we 
can do.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, an illustrious lineup of Umamusume 
assembled at Nakayama Racecourse in the 
depths of winter.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And here it is, this year's Arima Kinen! A 
stellar cast of powerhouse contenders has 
gathered!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"First up, from the Classic class! The 
autumn Tenno Sho Umamusume, Symboli Kris 
S! Along with No Reason and Hishi 
Miracle!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"It has been a long time, Kris S-dono. I 
am glad you have stepped forward."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ending the year on a sluggish note without 
settling things like this leaves a rather 
foul taste in one's mouth, after all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Agreed—No Reason.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"The end of the year. Until the very 
end――I shall fulfill my duty."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho, by all means, aim that rifle of yours 
at me. However—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Think you can hit me? I'm not such a fool 
as to stand here and let myself get shot, 
you know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sparks were already flying. However, 
Symboli Kris S was not the only one to 
watch out for today.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Good to meetcha, you must be the talk 
of the town, Lord Shogun!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to steering the race, just 
leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Lord Tap Dance City, is it...? I have 
heard her breakthrough charge rivals that 
of a naval commander.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working with you, 
Shogun-sama♪

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well, Lady Fine Motion. To come 
welcome me before the foreign highness, I 
am deeply humbled..."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"The Triple Crown route and the Triple 
Tiara route. Though we're from the same 
generation, we never had the chance to 
race together, after all."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ha, greetings are such a pain. We're meant 
to duke it out on the racetrack, aren't 
we?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho, Jungle Pocket-dono... Quite the 
brawler, just as the rumors say.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working with you, No 
Reason-san.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, model student Lady Narita Top 
Road. Truly a gathering of great talents. 
And—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason's eyes flashed sharply. What 
those eyes locked onto was—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
No Reason, huh... Tch, an unpredictable 
one just showed up.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Well, feel free to run amok to your 
heart's content. Upon this board of 
predetermined fate.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
One of the Clan of Silence... The 
arithmetician Lord Air Shakur. However...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, is this the only one from the Silent 
clan? Surprisingly short-handed, aren't 
they.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh? Silent... what did you say?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Very well. Having only one opponent is 
admittedly a bit of a letdown, but—"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
For today, let's just say they were 
terrified of my unstoppable advance.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Now then, if the Clan of Silence is thinly 
guarded, that means—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Lord Kris S, it appeareth that thou art to 
be my greatest adversary this day.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
While the cat's away, as they say. Now, 
let us venture into the decisive battle!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Hmph――just what I wanted.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surprisingly, the Clan of Silence is few 
in number. In that case, the chances of 
winning are high.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason and Symboli Kris S each set 
their sights on their target. A battle of 
kill or be killed had begun.
